2800.name: Principal's Office

east.description: To the east lies Inside the School House.

2800.description:
A narrow office smelling of beeswax and old paper, with a broad desk
scarred by decades of ink rings. Framed certificates hang crooked above
a shelf of leather-bound registers, and a brass bell-pull dangles by the
window. A single hard chair sits before the desk, polished smooth by
nervous sitters. The only way out is the door east into the school's
main hall.

2801.name: Inside the School House

north.description: To the north lies Downstairs Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Janitor's Office.

south.description: To the south lies Entrance of the School House.

west.description: To the west lies Principal's Office.

up.description: To the up lies Upstairs Hallway.

2801.description:
The great hall of the school house is a bustle of boots on scuffed
boards, with the lesson bell hanging from a rope beside the stairs. Rows
of pegs hold forgotten caps and satchels, and slates are stacked in
leaning towers against the wall. Doors lead east to the janitor's office
and west to the principal's, while the hallway runs on north past the
classrooms. Stairs climb up to the floor above, and the entrance porch
lies south.

2802.name: Janitor's Office

west.description: To the west lies Inside the School House.

2802.description:
A cluttered cupboard of a room smelling of lye, turpentine and wet rope.
Mops hang from hooks, brooms lean in a bristly bunch, and a great ring
of keys hangs on a nail above a bench littered with screws and tins of
polish. A cot is folded against the wall under a shelf of oilcans. The
only door leads west back to the main hall.

2803.name: Counselor's Office

west.description: To the west lies Downstairs Hallway.

2803.description:
A small, calm room where the noise of the school seems far away. Two
soft chairs face each other over a faded rug, and a kettle sits on a
little spirit stove beside a jar of honey. Shelves hold storybooks and a
box of carved wooden animals, and a potted fern droops in the window.
The door west leads out to the hallway.

2804.name: Downstairs Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Downstairs Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Counselor's Office.

south.description: To the south lies Inside the School House.

2804.description:
Chalk dust hangs in the air of this long hallway, drifting through
slanting light from a high window. Pegs line the wall at child height,
and a worn runner of rag carpet muffles little of the noise. A door east
bears a small brass plate for the counselor, while an open doorway west
shows a classroom. The hallway goes on north, and south it opens back
into the main hall.

2805.name: Classroom

east.description: To the east lies Downstairs Hallway.

2805.description:
Neat rows of desks face a board ruled with lines for practising
handwriting, each stroke looped and slanted just so. Quills stand in a
jar on the teacher's table beside a pot of sand for blotting. Copybooks
lie open on the desks, blotted and crossed out in a variety of styles.
Light from a high window falls on a single door east, which leads to the
hallway.

2806.name: Outhouse

east.description: To the east lies Downstairs Hallway.

2806.description:
A narrow plank outhouse, leaning slightly, with a crescent moon cut high
in the door and a draught whistling through the knots. A long bench with
two holes sits above a bucket of lime, and squares of cloth hang on a
nail. The graffiti of passing generations is scratched into the boards,
much of it misspelled. The door opens east into the school hallway.

2807.name: Downstairs Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Downstairs Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Downstairs Hallway.

2807.description:
Slates hang from nails along this stretch of hallway, each chalked with
a name and a sum gone wrong. The floorboards are worn into a shallow
groove down the middle by years of hurrying feet. East, a classroom door
stands ajar, and west a plank door with a crescent cut in it leads out
to the outhouse. A draught carries a whiff of lye soap from that way,
and the hall continues north and south.

2808.name: Classroom

west.description: To the west lies Downstairs Hallway.

2808.description:
Beads strung on wooden frames stand along the sills of this counting
room, and a tall abacus clacks gently in the draught. Sums in a looping
hand cover the board, with one smudged correction in red. Stools stand
in a ragged ring around a table piled with pebbles and tally sticks. The
door west opens to the hallway.

2809.name: Classroom

west.description: To the west lies Downstairs Hallway.

2809.description:
Maps of coasts and kingdoms hang from rollers over the board of this
classroom, their edges curling with age. A big painted globe stands on a
tripod by the window, with one dent in its ocean where a careless elbow
met it. A tin of coloured chalk, a rail of pointers and a table of salt-
dough hills complete the room. The door west leads to the hallway.

2810.name: Downstairs Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Downstairs Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Downstairs Hallway.

2810.description:
Two doors face each other across the hallway here, one east and one
west, both propped open with doorstops made from old iron weights. A
tall cabinet against the wall holds rolled maps and a dented globe. The
air is thick with the smell of ink and damp wool. Muddy bootprints cross
the boards in all directions, and the hall continues north and south.

2811.name: Classroom

east.description: To the east lies Downstairs Hallway.

2811.description:
A sing-song classroom, with a tall wooden stand holding a tuning fork
and a dented brass horn. Benches are arranged in tiers facing a lectern,
and songsheets lie scattered across the boards in curling pages. The
walls are hung with rhymes copied out in big, wobbly letters. A door
east returns to the hallway.

2812.name: Coach's Office

north.description: To the north lies Fencing Hall.

east.description: To the east lies Downstairs Hallway.

2812.description:
A cramped office cluttered with whistles, stopwatches and leather balls
gone hard as stone. A battered desk is buried under rosters, and a cork
board bristles with pinned team lists and faded ribbons. The place
smells of boiled sweets and rubbing oil. A door north leads into the
fencing hall, and another east opens on the hallway.

2813.name: Downstairs Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Downstairs Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Downstairs Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Coach's Office.

2813.description:
The hallway smells of liniment and leather here, and a rack of wooden
practice swords leans by the wall. Scuffed mats are stacked at the foot
of the plaster beside a bucket of sand. A hand-painted sign on the west
door announces the coach's office, while the classroom door east is
plain oak. The hall goes on north toward the rear of the school and back
south the way you came.

2814.name: Classroom

west.description: To the west lies Downstairs Hallway.

2814.description:
Rows of sloped wooden desks fill this classroom, each with an inkwell
and a carved groove for pens. A high stool stands before a slate board
covered with the alphabet in careful copperplate. A string of picture
cards runs along one wall, and a bucket of damp sponges waits beneath
it. The only door opens west onto the hallway.

2815.name: Fencing Hall

east.description: To the east lies Downstairs Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Coach's Office.

2815.description:
A long, bare hall with a floor of pale boards chalked with lunge lines
and the footwork of a hundred lessons. Wooden foils and padded jackets
hang in tidy rows along a rack, and a tall mirror, flecked with age,
throws back the light from the high windows. Prize ribbons droop from
the rafters. An arch east leads back to the hallway, and a narrow door
south opens on the coach's office.

2816.name: Downstairs Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Behind The School House.

south.description: To the south lies Downstairs Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Fencing Hall.

2816.description:
The hallway ends in a heavy back door, rattling slightly in its frame,
which opens north onto the yard behind the school. Cold air creeps
beneath it and stirs the dust on the boards. To the west a wide arch
gives onto the fencing hall, from which the clack of practice blades
sometimes echoes. A coat of tarred canvas hangs stiff with old rain on a
peg, and the hallway runs back south.

2817.name: Behind The School House

north.description: To the north lies Dirt Track.

east.description: To the east lies Horse Stable.

south.description: To the south lies Downstairs Hallway.

2817.description:
A trampled yard lies behind the school house, bare of grass where
generations of boots have packed it to hard earth. A scrubbed stone
trough stands by the wall and a rain barrel gurgles under the eave. The
timber back door leads south into the hallway, a cinder path leads on
north to a covered track, and the stable's wide doors face east. Washing
lines sag across the corner, hung with a few forgotten scarves.

2818.name: Horse Stable

north.description: To the north lies Dirt Track.

west.description: To the west lies Behind The School House.

2818.description:
The stable is a tall, dim barn of timber with stalls along either side,
their half-doors gnawed at the top by bored teeth. Straw lies deep on
the floor and a sweet smell of oats and leather fills the air. A saddle
rack and a bucket of brushes sit by the entrance. The yard behind the
school lies west through the wide doors, and a covered track leads
north.

2819.name: Dirt Track

east.description: To the east lies Dirt Track.

south.description: To the south lies Behind The School House.

2819.description:
A dirt track runs beneath a long timber awning propped on rough posts,
its beaten earth rutted by cartwheels. Rain-stained beams overhead drip
faintly onto a row of upturned buckets. The covered way bends here, with
the yard behind the school lying south and the track continuing east. A
smell of hay and harness drifts along it.

2820.name: Dirt Track

south.description: To the south lies Horse Stable.

west.description: To the west lies Dirt Track.

2820.description:
The covered track ends against the stable wall, its earth churned soft
by hooves and scattered with strands of straw. Harness hooks stud the
posts, each hung with a bridle gone stiff with age. The stable stands
south through a wide arch, while the track runs back west. Light falls
in dusty bars through gaps in the roof boards.

2821.name: Upstairs Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Upstairs Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies The Philosophy Classroom.

down.description: To the down lies Inside the School House.

2821.description:
At the head of the stairs the upper hallway opens, its boards creaking
at every step. A banister rubbed glossy by hands curves around the
stairwell, which descends to the main hall below. East, a door carved
with a laurel wreath marks the philosophy classroom, and the hallway
runs on north. A skylight pours pale light over a long bench where
latecomers wait.

2822.name: The Philosophy Classroom

west.description: To the west lies Upstairs Hallway.

2822.description:
A bare, quiet room where the benches are set in a circle instead of
rows. A single question is chalked on the board, with a scatter of
arguments crossed out beneath it. Cushions have been worn flat by long
thinking, and a sundial hangs oddly on the wall as if time were a puzzle
too. The only door leads west to the hallway.

2823.name: Classroom

west.description: To the west lies Upstairs Hallway.

2823.description:
A classroom for languages and speechmaking, with a raised lectern at one
end and rows of benches facing it. Lists of foreign words are chalked in
columns on the board, with their meanings left blank for the unwary. A
small mirror hangs by the lectern so that a nervous speaker may watch
their own face. The door west opens onto the hallway.

2824.name: Upstairs Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Upstairs Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Upstairs Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Woodcrafting Workshop.

2824.description:
Sawdust drifts along the hallway from the workshop door west, and the
sweet scent of cut pine mingles with chalk. A row of coat hooks carved
into the shapes of acorns and owls lines the wall, clumsy and proud.
East, a plain door opens on a classroom. The hallway continues north and
back south.

2825.name: Woodcrafting Workshop

east.description: To the east lies Upstairs Hallway.

2825.description:
The workshop is loud with the memory of mallets, and its floor is a
drift of curled shavings. Workbenches carry vices, planes and chisels in
neat racks, while half-built stools and toy boats wait on the shelves
for glue to dry. A pot of hot resin sits over a tiny brazier. The only
door leads east to the upstairs hallway.

2826.name: Mathematics Classroom

east.description: To the east lies Upstairs Hallway.

2826.description:
Slate boards cover three walls of the mathematics classroom, packed with
triangles, circles and long columns of figures. Wooden models of cones
and cubes sit on the sills beside a pair of giant brass compasses. A
chalk line has been drawn across the floor and labelled the equator, for
reasons nobody remembers. The door east leads out to the hallway.

2827.name: Upstairs Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Upstairs Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Upstairs Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Mathematics Classroom.

2827.description:
A tall window lets grey light fall across a mural of numbers painted
along the wall, from one to a hundred, with tiny grinning faces drawn
inside the zeros. West, a door with a brass plate showing a compass and
set square opens on the mathematics classroom. The hallway runs on north
toward more doors and back south.

2828.name: Upstairs Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Science Classroom.

east.description: To the east lies History Classroom.

south.description: To the south lies Upstairs Hallway.

2828.description:
The hallway ends in a small landing where three doors meet. The door
north has a chipped glass window and a smell of vinegar and burnt
sulphur seeping through it, while east a faded timeline of kings is
tacked to the frame of the history room. The west door stands plain
beside a fire bucket, and the hallway leads back south.

2829.name: History Classroom

west.description: To the west lies Upstairs Hallway.

2829.description:
A long timeline is painted along the wall of this room, from cave
paintings to the founding of the city, with dates scrawled beside it in
chalk. A sand table holds a model of a siege, its toy walls toppled by
many a reenactment. Cracked plaster busts of old rulers stare down from
a shelf. The door west returns to the hallway.

2830.name: Science Classroom

south.description: To the south lies Upstairs Hallway.

2830.description:
Benches scarred with acid burns run the length of this laboratory,
crowded with stoppered jars of coloured salts and cloudy liquids. A
brass microscope sits under a glass dome beside a tray of pressed ferns
and a hanging prism that scatters rainbows over the ceiling. The air
tastes faintly of sulphur. The only door leads south to the hallway.

2831.name: Classroom

east.description: To the east lies Upstairs Hallway.

2831.description:
Easels and drawing boards crowd this bright classroom, and charcoal
smudges every surface from the sills to the ceiling beams. A still life
of apples, a jug and a tarnished candlestick sits on a stool, drawn a
hundred times over. Pinned sketches curl on a line of string. The door
east leads back to the hallway.

2832.name: Entrance of the School House

north.description: To the north lies Inside the School House.

south.description: To the south lies Before the Garathorm School House.

2832.description:
The entrance porch is a draughty square of worn tiles with a boot
scraper by the doorpost and a rack for wet cloaks. Heavy double doors
stand open south onto the dirt track outside, and a notice board by them
bristles with timetables and curling reminders. A brass handbell for
visitors sits on a ledge. A door north leads into the main hall of the
school.
